# SQL-on-FHIR-v2 repo tests

Test files in this directory are vendored from the `/tests` directory of the
[sql-on-fhir.js repository](https://github.com/FHIR/sql-on-fhir.js). Note this
is where the shared test-suite lives now; it used to be in the `/tests`
directory of the [sql-on-fhir](https://github.com/HL7/sql-on-fhir) repo, until
that repo was reduced to hold only the Implementation Guide (see
[this commit](https://github.com/HL7/sql-on-fhir/commit/48f3607965d245aa756cb85517b1c0215c9c0e71)).

They are used to make sure that our implementation complies with the spec.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are managed by
[`utils/sof_tests/update_sof_tests.py`](../../../../../../utils/sof_tests/README.md):

```bash
python3 utils/sof_tests/update_sof_tests.py            # re-import at the current pin
python3 utils/sof_tests/update_sof_tests.py --ref main # move the pin forward
```

The import is pinned to an exact upstream commit recorded in
`utils/sof_tests/upstream.lock`, so re-running it is reproducible and an
upstream change cannot break our build until someone deliberately bumps the pin.

Some tests are excluded rather than modified; see
[`SKIPPED_TESTS` and `SKIPPED_COLLECTIONS`](../../java/com/google/fhir/analytics/view/SQLonFHIRv2Test.java)
in `SQLonFHIRv2Test`.

## Local deviation in `fn_reference_keys.json`

`fn_reference_keys.json` is the one file we do not vendor verbatim. We have
special constraints on `getResourceKey()` and `getReferenceKey()` in FHIRPaths:
both are matched on the whole column path, so the composite expressions that the
upstream version uses (e.g., `getResourceKey() = link.other.getReferenceKey()`)
are split into two separate columns here.

That replacement lives in `utils/sof_tests/overlays/`, guarded by the SHA-256 of
the upstream file it replaces, so the re-import fails loudly if upstream ever
changes it. See the
[vendoring README](../../../../../../utils/sof_tests/README.md) for the
rationale and for what to do when the guard trips.

## Regenerating the conformance result file

Whenever these files are re-imported, regenerate
`sql-on-fhir-v2-test-result.json` as well (it is placed in the parent directory
so it is not mistaken for a test case, and so the test-discovery walk does not
pick it up). It is referenced in the sql-on-fhir.js repo's
[implementations.json](https://github.com/FHIR/sql-on-fhir.js/blob/main/implementations.json).
It is generated by each
[`SQLonFHIRv2Test`](../../java/com/google/fhir/analytics/view/SQLonFHIRv2Test.java)
run. Pass `-Dsofv2.resultFile` to write it straight to its checked-in location:

```bash
mvn test -pl pipelines/common -am -Dtest=SQLonFHIRv2Test \
    -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
    -Dspotless.apply.skip=true \
    -Dsofv2.resultFile=$(pwd)/pipelines/common/src/test/resources/sql-on-fhir-v2-test-result.json
```

Without that property the report goes to a temp file, whose path the test logs.
Note that temp directory is platform dependent: on macOS it is the private
per-user directory in `$TMPDIR` (`/var/folders/.../T/`), **not** `/tmp`, and each
run leaves a new randomly-named file there. See the
[vendoring README](../../../../../../utils/sof_tests/README.md) for details.
